foreignQualification.feeBasis: Online base filing fee of $100.00 for the Foreign Registration Statement; paper submissions add a $20.00 manual processing fee.

foreignQualification.ongoingObligationsNote: File an annual report with the Idaho Secretary of State and maintain a registered agent in Idaho.

FOREIGN REGISTRATION STATEMENT Title 30, Chapter 21, Idaho Code Base Filing fee: $100.00 + $20.00 for manual processing (form must be typed).
Completed paper forms may be mailed or hand delivered to the Secretary of State's Office.
Register a business Search for a business File an annual report Access your business filings Request a certificate of existence
Make sure you have: A business name A registered agent in Idaho

notes: The record carries the online base fee ($100); a paper filing costs $120 total ($100 base fee plus the $20.00 manual processing fee). The form is revised 01/2019 and cites Title 30, Chapter 21, Idaho Code.
